title: Kayak Vacation Packages Scraper
description: Find Kayak flight-and-hotel packages with destination, fare, lodging details, provider, and booking link. Batch origin-destination pairs and choose future travel dates.

package_searches.title: Package destinations
package_searches.description: Package destinations and origin airports to search together.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: KAYAK destination code for the vacation-package search.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin airport code for the route or destination search.

departure_date.title: Departure Date
departure_date.description: Outbound travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, departure is set to 30 days from today.

return_date.title: Return Date
return_date.description: Return travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format after departure. When omitted, return is set to four days after departure.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult travelers included in the search.

child_ages.title: Child Ages
child_ages.description: Ages of children included in the stay, when applicable.

price_mode.title: Price Mode
price_mode.description: Whether quoted prices are shown as totals or per-night or per-person values. Accepted values: perperson, total.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a.
